app.name: YouTube
app.description: The world's largest video-sharing platform for watching, uploading, and discovering video content across all genres.

verdict.one_liner: Tracks every video you watch for personalized ads, but offers strong privacy controls to manage your data.
verdict.summary: YouTube collects extensive data about videos you watch, searches you make, and interactions with content and ads. This data is used to personalize recommendations and show targeted ads across Google services and partner sites. Google states it does not share personally identifying information with advertisers. Users can pause/delete YouTube history, manage ad settings, and export/delete account data.
verdict.recommendation_reason: YouTube's ad targeting is extensive and tracks activity across Google services and third-party sites, but the privacy controls are real and functional. Best suited for users comfortable managing privacy settings.

red.title: Tracks activity across third-party sites and apps
red.plain_english: Google collects activity on third-party sites and apps that use Google services, and may associate this with your personal information depending on your settings.

red.title: Uses your activity to show personalized ads
red.plain_english: Google collects videos you watch and searches you make to show personalized ads based on your interests across Google services and partner sites.

red.title: Estimates location from IP and other signals
red.plain_english: Google collects location via IP address, Wi-Fi access points, cell towers, and Bluetooth devices. Approximate location may be inferred even without using location features.

red.title: Retains some data for extended periods
red.plain_english: Google keeps some data until you delete your account, and retains data for longer periods for security, fraud prevention, and legal purposes.

green.title: Does not share identifying info with advertisers
green.plain_english: Google states it does not share information that personally identifies you with advertisers, such as your name or email, unless you explicitly ask it to.

green.title: Strong ad controls in My Ad Center
green.plain_english: You can control what information is used to show ads, modify interests, and turn off personalized advertising entirely.

green.title: Can pause and delete YouTube history
green.plain_english: You can pause and delete your YouTube Search History and Watch History at any time.

green.title: Policy changes cannot reduce rights without consent
green.plain_english: Google explicitly states it will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Camera and microphone accessed when you upload videos or use features like live streaming. Voice and audio information may be collected as activity data.
categories.detail: Camera and microphone are used when creating and uploading video content, live streaming, or using voice search features. The policy mentions collection of voice and audio information as activity data. Access is optional and on-demand for content creation features.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect the content you create, upload, or receive from others when using our services... photos and videos you save... Voice and audio information
concerns: Voice and audio collected as activity data

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Location collected via GPS (with permission), IP address, Wi-Fi, cell towers, and Bluetooth for features and ads.
categories.detail: Location is collected through multiple methods: GPS and sensor data from device (with permission), IP address, activity on Google services, and nearby Wi-Fi/cell/Bluetooth signals. Used for features like local search results and location-based ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect location information when you use our services... GPS and other sensor data from your device, IP address, Activity on Google services, Information about things near your device, such as Wi-Fi access points, cell towers, and Bluetooth-enabled devices
concerns: IP address used for location inference

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Contact info may be accessed when sharing content or if you choose to add a phone number to your Google Account.
categories.detail: Contacts may be accessed when sharing content or suggesting recipients. You can choose to add a phone number to your Google Account. Communication information includes people with whom you communicate or share content.
categories.policy_excerpt: helping you share content by suggesting recipients from your contacts... People with whom you communicate or share content

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Accesses photos and videos when you upload content to YouTube.
categories.detail: Storage access is required for uploading videos and photos to YouTube. Content you create, upload, or receive is collected and stored. This includes videos you upload and photos you save.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect the content you create, upload, or receive from others when using our services. This includes things like... photos and videos you save

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Shares data with affiliates, service providers, and partners. Non-personally identifiable information shared with advertisers and partners.
categories.detail: Data shared with Google affiliates, trusted businesses/service providers, and for legal reasons. Non-personally identifiable information shared publicly and with partners like publishers, advertisers, developers. Specific partners can collect information for advertising and measurement.
categories.policy_excerpt: We provide personal information to our affiliates and other trusted businesses or persons to process it for us... We may share non-personally identifiable information publicly and with our partners — like publishers, advertisers, developers, or rights holders
concerns: Non-personally identifiable info shared with advertisers
Partners can collect information using their own cookies

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Requires Google Account with name, password, and optional phone number and payment info.
categories.detail: Creating a Google Account requires personal information including name and password. Optional phone number and payment information can be added. Account information used across Google services.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create a Google Account, you provide us with personal information that includes your name and a password. You can also choose to add a phone number or payment information to your account.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Extensive tracking across Google services and third-party sites for personalized ads.
categories.detail: Tracks videos watched, searches made, views/interactions with content and ads, voice/audio info, purchase activity, and activity on third-party sites/apps using Google services. Used to show personalized ads based on interests and activity across Google services. Information from other sites may be linked and associated with personal information.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect information about your activity in our services... Terms you search for, Videos you watch, Views and interactions with content and ads... Activity on third-party sites and apps that use our services... Depending on your account settings, your activity on other sites and apps may be associated with your personal information
concerns: Activity may be associated with personal information
Search activity linked to ad performance

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: YouTube is not directed at children under 13. YouTube Kids is a separate app designed for children.
categories.detail: Standard YouTube is intended for users 13+. YouTube Kids is available as a separate, COPPA-compliant app for younger children. Parental controls available through Google Family Link.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can use our services in a variety of ways to manage your privacy... You can also choose to browse the web in a private mode

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Collects IP address, crash reports, system activity, and referrer URL automatically.
categories.detail: Network information collected includes IP address, crash reports, system activity, date/time, and referrer URL of requests. Used to maintain services and detect security threats.
categories.policy_excerpt: IP address, crash reports, system activity, and the date, time, and referrer URL of your request

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Collects device type, settings, operating system, mobile network, carrier, apps installed, and unique identifiers.
categories.detail: Collects unique identifiers, browser type/settings, device type/settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, application version number, and which apps you've installed. Used for automatic updates, features, and dimming screen when battery low.
categories.policy_excerpt: unique identifiers, browser type and settings, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number... which apps you've installed

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Does not show personalized ads based on sensitive categories like health. No biometric data collection mentioned for YouTube.
categories.detail: Google explicitly states it does not show personalized ads based on sensitive categories such as race, religion, sexual orientation, or health. Voice and audio information collected as activity data, not biometric health data.
categories.policy_excerpt: We don't show you personalized ads based on sensitive categories, such as race, religion, sexual orientation, or health

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Payment information can be added to Google Account for purchases like YouTube Premium or Super Chat.
categories.detail: Payment information is optional and can be added to your Google Account. Used for YouTube Premium, channel memberships, Super Chat, and other purchases. Processed according to Google's payment terms.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can also choose to add a phone number or payment information to your account

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Strong controls: My Activity to review/delete data, pause/delete YouTube history, export data, delete specific products or entire account.
categories.detail: Users have extensive deletion rights: My Activity to review and delete specific items, pause/delete YouTube Search and Watch History, export data from Google Account, delete specific Google products, or delete entire Google Account. Some data auto-deletes after set period, some kept until account deletion, some retained for legal/security purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can export a copy of content in your Google Account... Delete your content from specific Google services... Delete specific Google products... Delete your entire Google Account

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Google explicitly states it will not reduce your rights without your explicit consent. Changes notified by updating 'Last Updated' date.
categories.detail: Google explicitly commits to not reducing user rights without explicit consent. Policy updates are notified by updating the 'Last Updated' date. Archived versions available. For M&A, users get notice before personal information is transferred.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent... If Google is involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, we'll continue to ensure the confidentiality of your personal information and give affected users notice
